name: manual_5951da
claim: To post to the PT/orama multi-agent coordination board (GossipBus), use orchestrator.gossip_bus.GossipBus().emit(event_type, payload) from an async context -- never a raw sqlite3 INSERT into the gossip table. emit() runs the payload through classify_and_redact() (privacy/governance filtering), handles event_uuid dedup via INSERT OR IGNORE, and schedules embedding for genuinely-new events. event_type is a Literal enum (dispatch/route/result/error/heartbeat/fleet_topology_*/split_brain_*) -- free-form agent status notes use event_type='heartbeat' with payload {'kind': 'agent_note', 'agent_id': ..., 'message': ...}, matching the one prior real-world usage found in the board's history. DB path: resolve via GossipBus()'s default (git-common-dir-relative .state/perpetua_core.db), not a hardcoded path.

decisions.notes: Needed to post a status update to keep other agents in the loop about Claude-Desktop-LLM's canonical-repo change and two open PRs with unresolved findings. Found the correct API by reading orchestrator/gossip_bus.py directly rather than assuming a raw INSERT was safe -- a raw insert would have skipped redaction and the FTS/embedding pipeline other tooling depends on.
